CREATIVE ARTS — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #8
====

GRADE: Grade 5
SUBJECT: CREATIVE ARTS
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 100
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Best practice when working on Painting and Mosaic: (1 mark)
   A. Disrupt classmates during Painting and Mosaic.
   B. Refuse all feedback on Painting and Mosaic.
   C. Damage equipment used for Painting and Mosaic.
   D. Practise Painting and Mosaic with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

2. Best practice when working on Rounders: (1 mark)

8. Best practice when working on Kenyan Folk Dance: (1 mark)

   D. Practise Kenyan Folk Dance with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

9. Best practice when working on Wind Musical Instruments: (1 mark)

   C. Practise Wind Musical Instruments with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

10. Best practice when working on Athletics: (1 mark)

12. Primary colours are: (1 mark)
   A. Red, blue, and yellow
   B. Green, orange, and purple
   C. Brown, pink, and gold
   D. Black, white, and grey

13. Best practice when working on Swimming 15 Or 2.6 Indigenous Kenyan Games 15 3.0 Appreciation in Creative Arts : (1 mark)

   B. Refuse all feedback on Swimming 15 Or 2.6 Indigenous Kenyan Games 15 3.0 Appreciation in Creative Arts .

15. Best practice when working on Rhythm: (1 mark)

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
16. In three clear sentences, explain Descant Recorder and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

17. In three clear sentences, explain Swimming 15 Or 2.6 Indigenous Kenyan Games 15 3.0 Appreciation in Creative Arts  and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
